blocks.title: WordCraft in the activity panel
blocks.description: A ribbon, styles, tables and tracked changes — the upstream WordCraft editor running inside Astravia, on the document you opened in the workspace.

showcase.user_prompt: Tighten the second paragraph of report.docx and keep my changes tracked.
showcase.assistant_reply: WordCraft is open with the document. Turn on track changes first, then I will edit in place — I would rather leave the wording to you and only touch what you point at.

items.title: Styles carry the formatting
items.description: Headings, body text and captions come from named styles, so a document holds its shape when it is edited by someone else.

items.title: .docx in and out
items.description: Documents open from the workspace and export back to it as .docx, which is the format the rest of the world edits in.

items.title: Tracked changes, not silent edits
items.description: Revisions can be recorded instead of applied quietly, so a review is a conversation about visible marks.

items.title: Install the plugin
items.description: About 20 MB of editor files arrive on first open and are reused offline after that.

items.title: Open the WordCraft tab
items.description: The preparation screen is the hub fetching its payload.

items.title: Select a document, then open it
items.description: File → Open inside the editor takes the file selected in Astravia.

items.title: Export back through the workspace
items.description: Exports travel the same bridge as saves.

blocks.content: WordCraft covers the document model it models — long-form features such as mail merge or citation managers are not there yet. The plugin runs the pinned release.
